_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

segments.text: Light, Right, Glass, Grass. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Light, Right, Glass, Grass.

native.hook: LとRの違い、聞き分けられる？
native.caption: “light”と“right”、“glass”と“grass”はLとRだけが違います。Lは舌先を上の歯の後ろにつけ、Rは舌をどこにもつけません。Ama先生の口を見て、間の時間に続けて言ってみよう。Lexkiteアプリで練習。

en.hook: Can you hear the difference between L and R?
en.caption: “light” and “right”, “glass” and “grass” differ only in L and R. For L, touch the tip of your tongue behind your top teeth; for R, your tongue touches nothing. Watch teacher Ama’s mouth and say each one in the pause. Practice in the Lexkite app.
